nodes.name: Solid-state boronization of metal sheets
nodes.procedure: The boronization of a variety of metal sheets (e.g., Ni sheets) is realized by a solid-state boronizing method with a mixture of amorphous boron and potassium fluoroborate as the boronizing agent (Fig. S1 and details in Experimental section, ESI†). This simple boronizing technique results in the generation of single-phase sub-boride M₂B layers on the corresponding base metal sheets (M = Fe, Co, Ni and NiFe alloys).
nodes.source_text: The boronization of a variety of metal sheets (e.g., Ni sheets) is realized by a solid-state boronizing method with a mixture of amorphous boron and potassium fluoroborate as the boronizing agent (Fig. S1 and details in Experimental section, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: Boronized Fe, Co and Ni sheets exhibit XRD patterns matching standard Fe2B, Co2B and Ni2B with enhanced (002) peak intensity indicating preferential orientation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1c, the three boronized metal sheets exhibit similar X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns, which match well with the standard XRD patterns of Fe2B, Co2B and Ni2B, respectively...

nodes.characterization_summary: Cross-section elemental mapping shows Ni2B layer thickness of 8.7 μm on boronized Ni sheet.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elemental mapping analysis (Fig. 1e) for a cross-section of the boronized Ni sheet by the scanning electron microscopy-energy-dispersive X-ray spectrometry (SEM-EDS) reveals that the thickness of the Ni2B layer on the substrate is about 8.7 μm...

nodes.characterization_summary: Boronized Ni sheet shows smooth surface morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface morphology of the boronized Ni sheet was also studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The results (Fig. 1f and g) show that the boronized Ni sheet has a smooth surface...

nodes.characterization_summary: Boronized Ni sheet before OER has roughness factor of 1.01.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The results (Fig. 1f and g) show that the boronized Ni sheet has a smooth surface, with a roughness factor of 1.01.

nodes.characterization_summary: Boronized Ni sheet after OER shows Raman bands at 475 and 556 cm⁻¹ assigned to δ(NiIII-O) and ν(NiIII-O) vibrations of γ-NiOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2c shows the Raman spectra of the boronized Ni sheet after the OER... the material after the OER displays two Raman bands at 475 and 556 cm⁻¹, which are associated with the δ(NiIII-O) and ν(NiIII-O) vibrations of γ-NiOOH...

nodes.characterization_summary: B1s XPS of boronized Ni sheet before OER shows peaks at 192.2 eV (oxidized B) and 187.8 eV (Ni2B); after OER shows 191.6 eV (metaborate). Ni2p shows 0.3 eV shift to lower binding energy after OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The B1s spectrum for the boronized Ni sheet before the OER exhibits two peaks at 192.2 and 187.8 eV... the B1s spectrum for the boronized Ni sheet after the OER displays one peak at 191.6 eV, which can be assigned to metaborate species.

nodes.characterization_summary: Amorphous ultrathin (2-5 nm) metaborate-containing oxyhydroxide films observed on surfaces of boronized Ni sheets after OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) images reveal that there are amorphous, ultrathin (2-5 nm) films on the surfaces for the boronized Ni sheets (Fig. 2f–i)...
